armySpecialRules.name: State Troops
armySpecialRules.description:
If an enemy unit declares a charge against a State
Troop unit, and that unit chooses Hold or Stand &
Shoot as a charge reaction, then all non-fleeing and
unengaged State Troop units within 3" can make either
a Support Fire or a Support Charge action by
passing a Leadership test (which can be re-rolled if the
unit has a Leader). If the charged State Troops unit
does not get a charge reaction for any reason, then the
other State Troops units within range cannot make a
Support Fire or a Support Charge action.
Additionally, a State Troop unit can only declare one
Support Fire action, one Stand and Shoot reaction or
one Support Charge action per turn.
• Support Fire: A State Troop unit can only declare a
Support Fire action if at least one model in the unit is
armed with a missile weapon and the range between
the charging unit and the charged State Troops unit is
greater than the charging unit's Movement
characteristic.
If a Support Fire action is declared, the unit makes an
immediate, out of sequence shooting attack, resolved
as if it had just declared a Stand & Shoot charge
reaction against the charging unit. All unsaved
Wounds from the units' Stand & Shoot charge
reaction and/or Support Fire actions, are combined
when determining if the charging unit is required to
take a Heavy Casualties Panic test.
• Support Charge: A State Troop unit can declare a
Support Charge against an enemy unit's unengaged
arc, after your opponent has moved all of their
charging units, as long as one or more enemy units
has successfully completed a charge against the
charged State Troop unit. If a Support Charge action
is declared, the unit makes an out of sequence move
that is resolved as it had just declared a charge
against the charging unit. The enemy does not get to
make any charge reactions against a Support Charge,
but otherwise all the normal charging rules and
bonuses apply.

armySpecialRules.name: Cavalry Hammer
armySpecialRules.description:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
Combat +1 Armour Piercing (1),
Requires Two Hands

armySpecialRules.name: Grenade Launching Blunderbuss
armySpecialRules.description:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
9/18" 4 Armour Piercing (1)
Each Hit from a grenade launching blunderbuss is
multiplied into D6 Hits.

armySpecialRules.name: Hochland Long Rifle
armySpecialRules.description:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:

Sniper

armySpecialRules.name: Repeater Handgun
armySpecialRules.description:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
12/24" 5 Multiple Shots (3),
Ponderous,
Rapid Fire

armySpecialRules.name: Repeater Pistol
armySpecialRules.description:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
6/12" 5 Multiple Shots (3),
Quick Shot,
Rapid Fire
A repeater pistol can be used in combination with a
regular pistol as a brace of pistols, in which case they
fire Multiple Shots (4), but do not have Rapid Fire.

armySpecialRules.name: The Cult Of Ulric
armySpecialRules.description:
You may choose to field your army as the Cult of Ulric.
If you do, your Army General must have the Crush the
Weak special rule. A Cult of Ulric army may not take
magic items marked "Sigmarite only" or include Sisters
of Sigmar. The following special rules apply to the Cult
of Ulric:

armySpecialRules.name: Crush The Weak
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule have the Hatred special
rule against enemy models with a lower Weapon Skill,
Strength, Toughness or Leadership characteristic than
they have.

armySpecialRules.name: White Wolf Cloak
armySpecialRules.description:
White Wolf Cloaks give the wearer the Natural Armour
(6+) special rule against missile attacks.

armySpecialRules.name: Priests Of Ulric
armySpecialRules.description:
High Priests/Warrior Priests of Ulric replace Arch
Lectors/Warrior Priests of Sigmar. High Priests/Warrior
Priests of Ulric follow all the rules for Arch
Lectors/Warrior Priests of Sigmar with the following
exceptions:
• High Priests/Warrior Priests of Ulric have the Crush
the Weak and White Wolf Cloak special rules.
• Battle Prayers of Ulric: Battle Prayers of Ulric
replace Battle Prayers of Sigmar. A model with this
special rule knows the three Battle Prayers listed
below. They may attempt to use one at the start of
each of your turns by taking a Leadership test on
their own unmodified Leadership. If passed, the
prayer is answered and take immediate effect. A
friendly unit can only be under the effect of one
Battle Prayer at a time.
- Battle Howl: The model and any unit they are
with gain D6" to their charge moves until the
start of your next turn.
- Wrath of Winter: The model and any unit they
are with gain the Multiple Wounds (2) special
rule until the start of your next turn.
- Winter's Chill: Any unit in base contact with
the model suffer a -1 to hit until the start of your
next turn.
• Fury of Ulric: Fury of Ulric replaces Righteous
Fury. The Priest and any unit they join gain the
Immunity (Psychology) special rule.

armySpecialRules.name: The War Altar Of Ulric
armySpecialRules.description:
The War Altar of Ulric replaces the War Altar of
Sigmar. The War Altar of Ulric follows all the rules for
the War Altar of Sigmar, with the following exceptions:
• Icy Blast of Ulric: Icy Blast of Ulric replaces the
Golden Griffon. Enchanted Item. Bound Spell (Level
3, 9+ to cast). Icy Blast of Ulric is a magic missile
with a range of 18" that causes D6 Strength 5 Hits. In
addition, the target unit suffers -1 To Hit with missile
weapons and in close combat as well as its
Leadership until the start of the caster's next Magic
phase. Missile weapons that do not use Ballistics
Skull must roll a 4+ on a D6 before firing; if failed
they may not shoot that phase.
• The Power of Ulric: The Power of Ulric replaces the
Power of Sigmar. Any Battle Prayers of Ulric cast by
a model who is mounted on the War Altar of Ulric
also target all friendly units within 6".
• The Horn of Sigismund may not be taken.

armySpecialRules.name: Warriors Of Ulric
armySpecialRules.description:
Free Company Militia may be upgraded to Warriors of
Ulric for +2 points per model. They have Weapon Skill
4 and Leadership 7. Crush the Weak replaces the
Militia special rule. Warriors of Ulric may take great
weapons for +3 points per model. They may not take
pistols, bows or crossbows. They may take a Magic
Standard worth up to 25 points and ignore the
limitation on the number of Free Company Militia
units you may take.

armySpecialRules.name: Winter Wolf Knights
armySpecialRules.description:
Winter Wolves (Canine) replace Demigryphs. They
have Movement 9, but may not take barding.

armySpecialRules.name: Wolf Kin
armySpecialRules.description:
Wolf Kin replace Flagellants for +3 points per model.
They have Weapon Skill 4 and Leadership 8. Crush the
Weak, Skirmishers and Stubborn replace The End is
Nigh!, Fanatical Zeal, Prophecy of Doom and
Unbreakable. They may take great weapons for +3
points per model. They may not take flails.

magicItems.name: Beast Slayer, The Drakwald Runefang
magicItems.description:
General only. All hits from the Runefang wound
automatically and Ignores Armour saves.

magicItems.name: Daemonslayer Blade
magicItems.description:
Against Daemons, all attacks made with the
Daemonslayer Blade gain +1 To Wound with the
Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: Spear Of The Hierophant
magicItems.description:
Light lance/spear. Against Daemons, Undead and
Vampires, all attacks made with the Spear of the
Hierophant gain +1 Strength and any successful
Magical Ward saves must be re-rolled.

magicItems.name: Sword Of Fate
magicItems.description:
At the beginning of the battle, nominate one enemy
Character, Monstrous Creature or Monster on the
battlefield. The Sword of Fate will Wound that model
on a 2+ with the Ignores Armour Saves and Multiple
Wounds (D3) special rules.

magicItems.name: Blade Of Silvered Steel
magicItems.description:
This weapon gives the wielder the Hatred (Undead,
Vampires) special rule. In addition, no Undead or
Vampires may take armour or Regeneration saves
against it.

magicItems.name: Von Trickschotte'S Wondrous Arquebus
magicItems.description:
Hochland long rifle. This weapon has the following
profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
18/36" 6 Multiple Wounds (D3),
Ponderous,
Sniper
c and powerful magical artefacts used by the Empire.
in the Warhammer rulebook.

magicItems.name: Bronze Sigil Sword
magicItems.description:
Wizard only. This weapon gives the wielder +1
Strength and Toughness. In addition, the wielder gains
the Terror special rule against Goblins.

magicItems.name: The Mace Of Helsturm
magicItems.description:
Arch Lector only. Great weapon. The wielder of this
weapon gains the Flaming Attacks special rule. In
addition, each natural roll of 6 to hit causes that attack
to be resolved at Strength 10 and with the Multiple
Wounds (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: Sword Of Sigismund
magicItems.description:
Sigmarite only. The Sword of Sigismund gives the
wielder +1 Strength and the Always Strikes First
special rule.

magicItems.name: Hammer Of Judgement
magicItems.description:
Sigmarite only. Models hit by the Hammer of
Judgement must take a Toughness test for every Hit
suffered. If the test is failed, the Hit Wounds
automatically with the Ignores Armour Saves special
rule. If the test is passed, roll to Wound and take
armour saves as normal.
SWORD OF RIGHTEOUS STEEL* 15 points
Sigmarite only. The Sword of Righteous Steel makes
the wielder always Hit any opponent on roll of a 2+. In
addition, models Hit must re-roll successful Parry
saves.

magicItems.name: Pearl Daggers
magicItems.description:
Two hand weapons. This weapon gives the wielder the
Random Attacks (D3) special rule in addition to their
normal attacks.

magicItems.name: Wyrmslayer Sword
magicItems.description:
The Wyrmslayer Sword makes the wielder Wound on a
4+ or better, and ignores Natural Armour.

magicItems.name: The Armour Of Meteoric Iron
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. The Armour of Meteoric Iron grants the
wearer +2 armour save and the Magical Ward (6+)
special rule.

magicItems.name: Twice-Blessed Armour
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. This item contains a Bound Spell
(Level 1, cast on 3+). This is a direct damage spell
that causes 2D6 Strength 4 hits on one enemy unit in
base contact with the caster.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Righteous Fury
magicItems.description:
Witch Hunter only. Light armour. The wearer gains +1
Toughness and the Always Strikes First special rule.

magicItems.name: The Gilded Armour
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. Models attacking the wearer in close
combat must pass a Strength test before rolling to hit
for every Attack directed at the target. If the test is
failed, the Attack is lost. Attacks that do not roll to Hit
are unaffected.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Tarnus
magicItems.description:
Light armour. The Armour of Tarnus gives the wearer
the Magical Ward (5+) special rule. This item may be
taken by Wizards despite them normally not being
allowed to take armour.

magicItems.name: Shield Of The Gorgon
magicItems.description:
Shield. At the start of each round of close combat, the
Shield of the Gorgon causes one enemy model in base
contact of your choosing to suffer a -1 penalty to their
Attack characteristic for the remainder of the close
combat phase.

magicItems.name: Shroud Of Magnus
magicItems.description:
Sigmarite only. This item gives the bearer the Magical
Ward (5+) special rule. In addition, they and any unit
they join gain the Immunity (Fear, Terror) and Magic
Resistance (2) special rules.

magicItems.name: Amulet Of Thrice-Blessed Copper
magicItems.description:
All enemy attacks targeting the model wearing the
Amulet of Thrice-Blessed Copper suffer -1 To Wound.
In addition, the bearer gains the Immunity (Poisoned
Attacks) special rule.

magicItems.name: Icon Of Sigmar
magicItems.description:
Arch Lector only. The Icon of Sigmar gives its bearer
+1 Toughness.
JADE AMULET* 20 points
Sigmarite only. The Jade Amulet allows the wearer to
ignore the first wounding Hit they suffer (after saves).

magicItems.name: Mantle Of Illusions
magicItems.description:
Wizard with the Lore of Shadows only. All successful
rolls To Hit against the wearer must be re-rolled.
magicItems.restriction: Wizard with the Lore of Shadows only.

magicItems.name: Witch Hunter'S Ward
magicItems.description:
Witch Hunter only. This item gives the bearer and any
unit they join the Magic Resistance (2) special rule. In
addition, their armour save cannot be reduced below a
6+.

magicItems.name: The Crimson Amulet
magicItems.description:
The Crimson Amulet gives the wearer a Magical Ward
(6+). In addition, they automatically pass any
Characteristic tests they have to take.
SIGIL OF SIGMAR* 10 points
Sigmarite only. The Sigil of Sigmar gives the bearer a
4+ invulnerable save against enemy spells.
SLAYER'S HOURGLASS 10 Points
Any Monstrous Beast, Monstrous Creature or Monster
(including mounts, but not riders) in base contact with
the bearer of this item gains the Always Strikes Last
special rule.
magicItems.restriction:
The Crimson Amulet gives the wearer a Magical Ward
(6+). In addition, they automatically pass any
Characteristic tests they have to take.
SIGIL OF SIGMAR* 10 points
Sigmarite only.

magicItems.name: Grey Wand
magicItems.description:
Staff. The Grey Wand gives the wielder a +D3 casting
bonus. Roll for each spell casting attempt.

magicItems.name: Chalice Of Fate
magicItems.description:
Relic. The Chalice of Fate allows the Wizard to re-roll
failed Channelling rolls.

magicItems.name: Rod Of Power
magicItems.description:
Staff. At the end of each magic phase (yours and
enemy's), you can save up to three unused power/dispel
dice from the pool and store them in the rod. At the
beginning of each successive magic phase (yours and
enemy's), roll a dice. If the result is equal or higher to
the number of dice stored, add them to the
power/dispel dice pool, if the result is lower than the
number of dice stored, they are lost.

magicItems.name: Tome Of Midnight
magicItems.description:
Relic. The bearer of this item gains a +1 casting bonus
when using the Lore of Shadow or Death. In addition,
they know one more spell than normal. However, they
also have the Independant special rule.
SEAL OF DESTRUCTION* 15 points
Charm. One use only. After the bearer of the Seal of
Destruction manages to successfully dispel an enemy
spell, they may choose to use the Seal. If they do so,
roll a D6. On a 4+, the spell cannot be used by that
Wizard for the rest of the game.
magicItems.restriction:
Relic. The bearer of this item gains a +1 casting bonus
when using the Lore of Shadow or Death. In addition,
they know one more spell than normal. However, they
also have the Independant special rule.
SEAL OF DESTRUCTION* 15 points
Charm. One use only.

magicItems.name: Shemtek'S Grimoire
magicItems.description:
Charm. One use only. This item can be used at the start
of any enemy Magic Phase. Roll a D3, the result is the
casting penalty all enemy Wizards suffer for the
duration of this Magic Phase.
CRYSTAL BALL* 10 points
Relic. The Crystal Ball allows the wearer to pick one
enemy unit anywhere on the table at the start of each of
your turns. Your opponent must reveal all Magic Items,
Hidden models and the like that unit might have.

magicItems.name: Twin-Tailed Wand
magicItems.description:
Staff. Once per turn, the bearer of this item may
attempt to cast the same spell twice. However, any time
they roll a miscast, they suffer a +1 modifier to the
result on the Miscast table.
WIZARD'S STAFF* 10 points
Staff. The bearer can use one more Power dice than
they are normally allowed to from their Wizard Level.

magicItems.name: Fozzrik'S Folding Fortress
magicItems.description:
After deployment zones have been agreed, but before
the armies have been deployed, place a watchtower
building no more than 10x10 cm in base size and a
maximum of 3 floors in your deployment zone to
represent the Folding Fortress. This is treated as a
standard building. If you do not have a suitable
building to place, you cannot use Fozzrik's Folding
Fortress.

magicItems.name: Van Horstmann'S Speculum
magicItems.description:
When the wearer fights in a challenge, he must 'swap'
the Weapon Skill, Strength, Toughness, Initiative and
Attacks characteristics on his profile with his enemy
(but not the enemy's mount, if he has one). So, the
wearer fights with his enemy's Strength, Toughness,
Initiative and Attacks whilst his enemy fights with the
wearer's Strength, Toughness, Initiative and Attacks.
Note that you cannot choose not to use Van
Horstmann's Speculum and you must swap all of the
listed characteristics for the duration of the challenge,
not just some of them.

magicItems.name: Aldred'S Casket Of Sorcery
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell. At the start of each of your Magic phases,
roll a D6. On the roll of a 4+, the bearer may remove
and capture one randomly determined spell up to Level
2 (excluding Signature Spells) from an enemy Wizard
within 12". The bearer can then cast the captured spell
in any of your Magic phases by releasing it from the
casket just like from a Bound Spell. Any number of
spells may be captured by the casket, and the bearer
can successfully cast each one once, either over several
magic phases or all at the same time if they prefer.

magicItems.name: Doomfire Ring
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell. The Doomfire Ring contains the Burning
Head spell from the Lore of Fire.

magicItems.name: Ranald'S Coin
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item may re-roll 1's To Hit, To
Wound, when taking armour saves and invulnerable
saves.

magicItems.name: Ring Of Taal
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell. This item contains the Shield of Thorns
spell from the Lore of Life.

magicItems.name: Orb Of Thunder
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell (Level 1, cast on 3+). Remains in play.
The Orb of Thunder contains a hex aura spell with a
range of 24". While the spell is in effect, no models
within range may use their Fly special rule and must
move on the ground at their normal Movement rate.

magicItems.name: The Silver Horn
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell (Level 2, cast on 7+). The Silver Horn
contains an augment aura spell with a range of 12".
All affected units gain the Immunity (Psychology)
special rule until the start of your next Magic phase.

magicItems.name: Antler Of The Blue Stag
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item and any unit they join gain +1
Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill.

magicItems.name: Eichelbaum'S Scroll
magicItems.description:
Witch Hunter only. Once per turn, when an enemy spell
has been cast, the bearer can use this item instead of
attempting to dispel the spell by using dispel dice. This
gives them 3 free dice to attempt to dispel the spell,
which cannot be combined with any other dispel dice.
This may also be used to dispel spells that Remains in
Play. However, if the dispel attempt fails, the scroll is
destroyed and cannot be used for the remainder of the
battle.

magicItems.name: Helsturm'S Staff
magicItems.description:
Arch Lector only. The model carrying Helsturm's Staff
and any unit they join gain the Cold-blooded special
rule.

magicItems.name: Balestorm Orb
magicItems.description:
Witch Hunter only. Enemy Wizards within 24" of the
bearer suffer a -1 penalty to cast spell.

magicItems.name: Brazier Of Holy Flame
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item gains the Hold Your Ground (6)
special rule.

magicItems.name: Black Pomander
magicItems.description:
Any Undead unit in base contact with the bearer of this
item suffer -1 to their Weapon Skill.

magicItems.name: Ring Of St. Horst
magicItems.description:
Sigmarite only. The model carrying the Ring of St.
Horst and any unit they join may re-roll any failed
Leadership test.

magicItems.name: Ring Of Volans
magicItems.description:
One use only. Bound Spell. At the beginning of the
game, choose one spell from any of the eight Winds of
Magic as if the bearer were a Level 1 Wizard. That
spell is bound within the Ring of Volans and is
automatically cast with a casting result equal to the
normal casting value of the spell, no power dice are
required.

magicItems.name: Blessed Silver Hammer
magicItems.description:
Sigmarite only. One use only. This item can be used at
the start of any round of close combat. All enemy
models in base contact with the bearer suffer a Strength
4 Hit with the Magical Attacks special rule. This is
increased to Strength 5 for Daemons, Undead and
Vampires.

magicItems.name: Book Of Uncommon Prayer
magicItems.description:
The bearer may re-roll one dice when taking
Leadership tests to use Battle Prayers of Sigmar.

magicItems.name: Boots Of Bovva
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. The model wearing the Boots of
Boova gains the Stomp (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: Icon Of Magnus
magicItems.description:
Sigmarite only. The Icon of Magnus gives the bearer
and any unit they are with the Immunity (Terror)
special rule.
POWDERS OF THRICE-DAMNED
OSSK* 15 points
Witch Hunter only. One use only. The Powders may be
used immediately when an enemy Wizard miscasts.
The Wizard must roll twice on the Miscast table, and
you pick which result is used.

magicItems.name: Reliquary Of Lector Ostranald
magicItems.description:
Sigmarite only. Each time the bearer's unit suffers
unsaved Wounds from a spell, the first D3 unsaved
Wounds are absorbed by the Reliquary and have no
effect (unsaved Wounds with the Multiple Wounds
special rule still only count as one).
SANCTIFIED SHARD OF
LICHEBONE* 15 points
Witch Hunter only. No Magical Wards may be used
against close combat Attacks made by the bearer.
SKULL CHARM* 15 points
At the start of the game, roll a D6 and consult the chart
below to determine which effect the Skull Charm has
on the wearer.
D6 Result
1-2 +1 Weapon Skill
3-4 +1 Leadership
5-6 +1 Weapon Skill & Leadership

magicItems.name: Squintsoffen'S Marvellous Magnifier
magicItems.description:
Master Engineer only. The bearer may re-roll failed
rolls To Hit with missile weapons (excluding artillery).
VON MECKLENBURG'S
ENCHANTED SHOT* 10 points
Witch Hunter with pistol(s) or handgun only. Any shots
fired from the bearer's weapons have the Magical
Attacks special rule and automatically Wounds.

magicItems.name: The Fang Of Orska
magicItems.description:
Any War Beast, Monstrous Beast, Monstrous Creature
or Monster (including mounts, but not riders)
attempting to strike blows against the bearer must first
pass a Leadership test or automatically forfeit any
attacks directed against the bearer.
RING OF FORTUNE* 5 points
One use only. The bearer (but not their mount) of this
item can re-roll all failed To Wound rolls in close
combat.
magicItems.restriction:
Any War Beast, Monstrous Beast, Monstrous Creature
or Monster (including mounts, but not riders)
attempting to strike blows against the bearer must first
pass a Leadership test or automatically forfeit any
attacks directed against the bearer.
RING OF FORTUNE* 5 points
One use only.

magicItems.name: Sheen Of Truesilver
magicItems.description:
At the end of any close combat in which a Monstrous
Infantry, Monstrous Beast, Monstrous Cavalry,
Monstrous Creature or Monster model suffers one or
more unsaved Wounds from the bearer's close combat
attacks, it must take a Toughness test for each such
Wound inflicted, and loses a Wound (with no saves
allowed) for each test failed.
SANCTIFIED SILVER BULLETS* 5 points
Witch Hunter with pistol(s) or handgun only. Any shots
fired from the bearer's weapons have the Multiple
Wounds (D3) special rule against Daemons, Undead
and Vampires.
magicItems.restriction:
At the end of any close combat in which a Monstrous
Infantry, Monstrous Beast, Monstrous Cavalry,
Monstrous Creature or Monster model suffers one or
more unsaved Wounds from the bearer's close combat
attacks, it must take a Toughness test for each such
Wound inflicted, and loses a Wound (with no saves
allowed) for each test failed.
SANCTIFIED SILVER BULLETS* 5 points
Witch Hunter with pistol(s) or handgun only.

magicItems.name: The Imperial Banner
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this standard gains the Hold Your Ground
(6) special rule. In addition, all friendly units within the
bearers Hold Your Ground range gain the Disciplined
special rule.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Sigismund
magicItems.description:
Sigmarite only. A unit with this standard gains the
Inspiring Presence (6) and Stubborn special rules.

magicItems.name: Griffon Standard
magicItems.description:
Sigmarite only. A unit with this standard doubles any
combat result bonus granted for having extra ranks.
However, the unit carrying the Griffon Banner cannot
pursue a fleeing enemy and must hold their ground
instead.

magicItems.name: Flag Of The Conqueror
magicItems.description:
All friendly units with the State Troops or Militia
special rules within 12" of this standard gain +1 to their
Leadership.

magicItems.name: Banner Of The Knights Panther
magicItems.description:
Knights with the Knights Panther upgrade only. A unit
with this standard gains the Unbreakable special rule.
magicItems.restriction: Knights with the Knights Panther upgrade only.

magicItems.name: Standard Of Arcane Warding
magicItems.description:
A unit with this standard gains the Magic Resistance
(2) special rule.

magicItems.name: Steel Standard
magicItems.description:
Knights or Demigryph Knights only. A unit with this
standard ignores the Movement penalties from barding.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Valour
magicItems.description:
A unit with this standard gains the Immunity (Panic)
special rule.

magicItems.name: Tapestry Of Sigmar'S Triumph
magicItems.description:
Sigmarite only. A unit with this standard may re-roll 1's
To Wound in the first round of close combat.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Duty
magicItems.description:
A unit with this standard automatically pass any Rally
tests.
ULRICAN MAGIC ITEMS
This section contains the rules for some of the most iconic
Ulric. These may only be taken in a Cult of Ulric army. T
in the Warhammer rulebook.

magicItems.name: Storm Hammer
magicItems.description:
Cavalry hammer. Models Hit in the turn the wielder
charges may not attack that turn.

magicItems.name: Winter'S Bite
magicItems.description:
On a to hit roll of 6, this weapon automatically Wounds
with the Ignores Armour saves special rule.

magicItems.name: Armour Of The Knight Eternal
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. Attacks against the wearer in close
combat suffer a -1 To Hit penalty.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Skoll
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. Attacks against the wearer in close
combat suffer a -1 Strength penalty. In addition, the
wearer gains Immunity (Lore of Light).

magicItems.name: Wolf Helm Of The Teutogens
magicItems.description:
6+ armour save. The wearer can take a Leadership test
at the start of every Close Combat phase. If passed,
they gain +1 Strength for the duration of that phase.

magicItems.name: Helm Of The Skavenslayer
magicItems.description:
6+ armour save. The wearer gains the Fear special rule.
Against models from a Skaven army, the wearer causes
Terror instead. However, all Skaven gain the Hatred
special rule while attacking the wearer.

These may be used in addition to the magic items found

magicItems.name: The White Cloak Of Ulric
magicItems.description:
The wearer gains the Ice Attacks, Immunity (Flaming
Attacks) and Magical Ward (5+) special rules.
